statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is clinically indicated due to the intermittent nature of symptoms to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances
